{{Quote|I have a standing invitation to spend time with the Skyraiders of ThonBoka. I may take them up on it.|[[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />}}
The '''Skyraiders of ThonBoka''' was an group of mount-riders active around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Theron Shan]], an [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent, was in good standing with them.<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />
